description: Jump velocity x0.85: take-off -495 -> -420.75 px/s, the cap -800 -> -680
note: The spec edits physics.jump_velocity in world1_1.yaml, but the game never reads that block (LevelLoader takes only `dynamics` from it), so that edit would change nothing. This scales the jump values the game does read; the small run-speed bonus (up to 57 px/s) is unchanged. A full jump still rises 4 tiles (5 before) and the tallest step on the route is 3, so 1-1 stays solvable.
